cards.headline: Kid Cudi rapped over it within weeks
cards.snippet: In May 2010, Pitchfork reported that Kid Cudi had posted a track called "All Talk" to his blog. It sampled LCD Soundsystem's "Dance Yrself Clean", the opening track of This Is Happening, which had been BNM'd. The song carried a verse from Cudi associate Chip Tha Ripper. It also used a sample of Christian Bale's expletive-filled rant from the set of Terminator: Salvation.
cards.context: Pitchfork reported the track in May 2010.

cards.headline: Muppets played it for a Brighton crowd
cards.snippet: In 2011, an unofficial video for "Dance Yrself Clean" appeared, directed by Javier Douglas. In it, Kermit the Frog, Animal, Miss Piggy and a baby Cookie Monster play the song for a surprised and delighted crowd in the British seaside town of Brighton. Pitchfork likened it to U2's "Where the Streets Have No Name" video, but with Muppets. The clip runs about nine minutes and includes Animal and Cookie getting drunk on the beach, plus some romantic moments for Kermit and Piggy.
cards.context: Pitchfork compared it to U2's "Where the Streets Have No Name" video.
